python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
root=Path('src/climate')
files=[p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.suffix in {'.h','.hpp','.c','.cc','.cpp'}]
print('=== LARGE FILES ===')
rows=[]
for p in files:
    try: n=sum(1 for _ in p.open(errors='ignore'))
    except OSError: continue
    rows.append((n,str(p)))
for n,p in sorted(rows, reverse=True)[:35]: print(f'{n:5d} {p}')
print('=== HEADER INCLUDE HOTSPOTS ===')
for p in sorted([p for p in files if p.suffix in {'.h','.hpp'}], key=lambda p: sum(1 for l in p.open(errors='ignore') if l.startswith('#include')), reverse=True)[:25]:
    c=sum(1 for l in p.open(errors='ignore') if l.startswith('#include'))
    print(f'{c:3d} {p}')
PY
